steps.name: environment - install minimal OS deps, create non-root user, persist minimal env
steps.description: Install minimal OS libraries required by headless Chromium, create or ensure a non-root user 'playwright' exists for running browsers/tests, persist minimal environment variables (DISPLAY) and PATH helper in /etc/profile.d/playwright.sh (written so npm global bin is resolved at shell source time). Validate node and npm versions and print them for traceability. Fail fast on apt update errors.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
PKGS=(fonts-liberation libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libx11-6 libgbm1 libasound2 libxcomposite1 libxrandr2 libxss1 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libpangocairo-1.0-0)
MISSING=()
for p in "${PKGS[@]}"; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING+=("$p"); done
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  sudo apt-get update -q || { echo "ERROR: apt-get update failed" >&2; exit 10; }
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y "${MISSING[@]}"
fi
# Ensure a non-root user exists for running browsers/tests
if ! id -u playwright >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash playwright || true; fi
sudo mkdir -p "$WS" && sudo chown -R playwright:playwright "$WS" || true
# Persist minimal environment: ensure DISPLAY and safe npm-global PATH resolution evaluated at shell source time
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/playwright.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
# Playwright minimal env (evaluated when the shell sources this file)
[ -z "${DISPLAY:-}" ] && export DISPLAY=:99
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_GBP="\$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "\$NPM_GBP" ] && [[ ":\$PATH:" != *":\$NPM_GBP:"* ]]; then
    export PATH="\$NPM_GBP:\$PATH"
  fi
fi
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/playwright.sh
# Validate Node/npm and print versions for traceability
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "ERROR: node not found" >&2; exit 3)
node -v && npm -v
NPM_MAJOR=$(npm -v | cut -d. -f1 || echo "0")
if [ "$NPM_MAJOR" -lt 8 ]; then echo "ERROR: npm >=8 required (found $(npm -v))" >&2; exit 4; fi

steps.name: scaffolding - initialize project, pin deps and create scripts (module-aware, safe edits)
steps.description: Initialize a minimal Node project in the workspace if package.json is missing. Pin playwright and @playwright/test to chosen versions if missing. Detect module type and create module-aware Playwright config (playwright.config.js or playwright.config.mjs). Create example test and a short-lived start-headless probe script. Update package.json scripts using a small temporary Node helper to avoid fragile shell quoting. Do not overwrite existing user files.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WS"
PW_VER="1.38.0"
PWTEST_VER="1.38.0"
# Initialize project if missing
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then npm init -y >/dev/null; fi
# Detect module system reliably
TYPE=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log(p.type||'') }catch(e){console.log('')}")
if [ "$TYPE" = "module" ]; then EXT="mjs"; IS_ESM=1; else EXT="js"; IS_ESM=0; fi
# Safely add scripts to package.json using a small helper JS (pass EXT as arg)
cat > /tmp/_pkg_write.js <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs');const ext=process.argv[2]||'js';const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));
p.scripts=p.scripts||{};
p.scripts['install-browser']='npx playwright install chromium';
p.scripts['test']='npx playwright test --reporter=list --forbid-only --workers=1';
p.scripts['test:headed']='npx playwright test --headed --reporter=list --forbid-only --workers=1';
p.scripts['start']=`node ./scripts/start-headless.${ext}`;
fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));
NODE
node /tmp/_pkg_write.js "$EXT" && rm -f /tmp/_pkg_write.js || true
# Install pinned deps only if missing
NEED_INSTALL=0
if ! node -e "try{require('./node_modules/playwright');process.exit(1)}catch(e){process.exit(0)}" 2>/dev/null; then NEED_INSTALL=1; fi
if ! node -e "try{require('./node_modules/@playwright/test');process.exit(1)}catch(e){process.exit(0)}" 2>/dev/null; then NEED_INSTALL=1; fi
if [ $NEED_INSTALL -eq 1 ]; then npm i -D "playwright@${PW_VER}" "@playwright/test@${PWTEST_VER}" --no-audit --no-fund --silent; fi
# Create module-aware Playwright config if missing
if [ $IS_ESM -eq 1 ]; then
  [ -f playwright.config.mjs ] || cat > playwright.config.mjs <<'CFG'
export default { use: { headless: true, launchOptions: { args: [] } }, timeout: 30000 };
CFG
else
  [ -f playwright.config.js ] || cat > playwright.config.js <<'CFG'
module.exports = { use: { headless: true, launchOptions: { args: [] } }, timeout: 30000 };
CFG
fi
# Create example test
mkdir -p tests
if [ $IS_ESM -eq 1 ]; then
  [ -f tests/example.spec.mjs ] || cat > tests/example.spec.mjs <<'JS'
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
test('simple headless run', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('about:blank'); const title = await page.title(); expect(typeof title).toBe('string'); });
JS
else
  [ -f tests/example.spec.js ] || cat > tests/example.spec.js <<'JS'
const { test, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
test('simple headless run', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('about:blank'); const title = await page.title(); expect(typeof title).toBe('string'); });
JS
fi
# Create short-lived start probe
mkdir -p scripts
START_FILE="scripts/start-headless.$EXT"
if [ ! -f "$START_FILE" ]; then
  if [ $IS_ESM -eq 1 ]; then cat > "$START_FILE" <<'NODE'
import playwright from 'playwright';
(async()=>{ const isRoot = typeof process.getuid==='function' && process.getuid()===0; const args = isRoot ? ['--no-sandbox','--disable-setuid-sandbox'] : []; const b = await playwright.chromium.launch({ headless: true, args }); const p = await b.newPage(); await p.goto('about:blank'); console.log('OK: chromium launched'); await b.close(); process.exit(0); })();
NODE
  else cat > "$START_FILE" <<'NODE'
const playwright = require('playwright');(async()=>{ const isRoot = typeof process.getuid==='function' && process.getuid()===0; const args = isRoot ? ['--no-sandbox','--disable-setuid-sandbox'] : []; const b = await playwright.chromium.launch({ headless: true, args }); const p = await b.newPage(); await p.goto('about:blank'); console.log('OK: chromium launched'); await b.close(); process.exit(0); })();
NODE
  fi
  chmod +x "$START_FILE"
fi
# Long-running agent for validation (simple HTTP server) - created but not used as start script by default
AGENT_FILE="scripts/agent.js"
if [ ! -f "$AGENT_FILE" ]; then cat > "$AGENT_FILE" <<'NODE'
const http = require('http');const server = http.createServer((req,res)=>res.end('ok'));
server.listen(3000,()=>console.log('AGENT_OK'));
process.on('SIGTERM',()=>server.close(()=>process.exit(0)));
NODE
  chmod +x "$AGENT_FILE"
fi

steps.name: dependencies - deterministic npm install and install Chromium browser only with probe
steps.description: Deterministically install project dependencies (npm ci if lockfile exists, otherwise npm install). Ensure playwright CLI present and install only Chromium when missing. Validate installed versions and verify browser functionality by running the short-lived start-headless probe; capture probe logs to /tmp and surface on failure. Print installed playwright and @playwright/test versions for traceability and fail on incompatible semver major mismatch.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WS"
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund; fi
# Ensure playwright CLI available
npx playwright --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "WARN: playwright CLI not available yet; proceeding to (re)install packages"
# Install chromium only if necessary: run probe; if probe fails attempt install once
PROBE_LOG=/tmp/playwright_probe.log
START_SCRIPT=""
if [ -f scripts/start-headless.mjs ]; then START_SCRIPT=scripts/start-headless.mjs; elif [ -f scripts/start-headless.js ]; then START_SCRIPT=scripts/start-headless.js; else echo "ERROR: start script missing" >&2; exit 6; fi
# Run probe
if node "$START_SCRIPT" > "$PROBE_LOG" 2>&1; then true; else
  echo "Probe failed, attempting npx playwright install chromium" >&2
  npx playwright install chromium || { tail -n 200 "$PROBE_LOG" >&2; echo "ERROR: playwright install chromium failed" >&2; exit 3; }
  # try probe again
  if ! node "$START_SCRIPT" >> "$PROBE_LOG" 2>&1; then tail -n 200 "$PROBE_LOG" >&2; echo "ERROR: runtime browser validation failed after install" >&2; exit 7; fi
fi
# Print versions for traceability
PW_INSTALLED=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/playwright/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('')}")
PWTEST_INSTALLED=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('')}")
echo "playwright:$PW_INSTALLED @playwright/test:$PWTEST_INSTALLED"
if [ -z "$PW_INSTALLED" ] || [ -z "$PWTEST_INSTALLED" ]; then echo "ERROR: playwright or @playwright/test not found in node_modules" >&2; exit 4; fi
PW_MAJ=${PW_INSTALLED%%.*}
PWT_MAJ=${PWTEST_INSTALLED%%.*}
if [ "$PW_MAJ" != "$PWT_MAJ" ]; then echo "ERROR: major version mismatch between playwright($PW_INSTALLED) and @playwright/test($PWTEST_INSTALLED)" >&2; exit 5; fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WS"
# Deterministic install: use npm ci if lockfile present, otherwise npm install
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund; fi
# Ensure playwright CLI available (npx will fetch if not globally installed)
if ! npx playwright --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WARN: playwright CLI not responding via npx; continuing (npx will bootstrap)" >&2; fi
# Determine probe script
PROBE_LOG=/tmp/playwright_probe.log
START_SCRIPT=""
if [ -f scripts/start-headless.mjs ]; then START_SCRIPT=scripts/start-headless.mjs; elif [ -f scripts/start-headless.js ]; then START_SCRIPT=scripts/start-headless.js; else echo "ERROR: start script missing (scripts/start-headless.js or .mjs)" >&2; exit 6; fi
# Run probe once; on failure attempt to install chromium and retry once
rm -f "$PROBE_LOG" || true
if node "$START_SCRIPT" > "$PROBE_LOG" 2>&1; then :; else
  echo "Probe failed, attempting to install chromium via Playwright CLI" >&2
  # Try install chromium only
  if ! npx playwright install chromium >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    tail -n 200 "$PROBE_LOG" >&2 || true
    echo "ERROR: playwright install chromium failed" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
  # retry probe
  if ! node "$START_SCRIPT" >> "$PROBE_LOG" 2>&1; then tail -n 200 "$PROBE_LOG" >&2 || true; echo "ERROR: runtime browser validation failed after install" >&2; exit 7; fi
fi
# Print installed versions for traceability
PW_INSTALLED=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/playwright/package.json').version)}catch(e){process.stdout.write('')}")
PWTEST_INSTALLED=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json').version)}catch(e){process.stdout.write('')}")
echo "playwright:${PW_INSTALLED:-<not-found>} @playwright/test:${PWTEST_INSTALLED:-<not-found>}"
if [ -z "${PW_INSTALLED:-}" ] || [ -z "${PWTEST_INSTALLED:-}" ]; then echo "ERROR: playwright or @playwright/test not found in node_modules" >&2; exit 4; fi
PW_MAJ=${PW_INSTALLED%%.*}
PWT_MAJ=${PWTEST_INSTALLED%%.*}
if [ "$PW_MAJ" != "$PWT_MAJ" ]; then echo "ERROR: major version mismatch between playwright($PW_INSTALLED) and @playwright/test($PWTEST_INSTALLED)" >&2; exit 5; fi
# Success indicator
echo "Playwright dependencies installed and browser probe passed. Probe log: $PROBE_LOG"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"

# Ensure dependencies
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund; fi
# Run short-lived probe
START_SCRIPT=""
if [ -f scripts/start-headless.mjs ]; then START_SCRIPT=scripts/start-headless.mjs; elif [ -f scripts/start-headless.js ]; then START_SCRIPT=scripts/start-headless.js; else echo "ERROR: start script missing" >&2; exit 2; fi
PROBE_LOG=/tmp/playwright_probe.log
node "$START_SCRIPT" > "$PROBE_LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$PROBE_LOG" >&2; echo "VALIDATION_FAILED: probe failed" >&2; exit 3; }
# Start long-running agent (scripts/agent.js)
AGENT_SCRIPT="scripts/agent.js"
if [ ! -f "$AGENT_SCRIPT" ]; then echo "ERROR: agent script missing" >&2; exit 4; fi
nohup node "$AGENT_SCRIPT" > /tmp/playwright_agent.log 2>&1 &
